name: Chelsea 2020/21 (Tuchel)
scopeNote: Thomas Tuchel's part of Chelsea's 2020/21 only: appointed 26 January 2021, first match 27 January 2021 (0-0 v Wolves; date from the Mastermind URL, page 403, and the Goal first-week article), to the Champions League final win over Manchester City on 29 May 2021 in Porto. Frank Lampard's earlier matches (Aug 2020-Jan 2021) are NOT counted, and season-wide stats (e.g. the club's appearance table, Lampard-era set-piece data) are used only as unverified context. Roughly 33 competitive matches fall in the spell (about 22 league, 4 FA Cup, 7 Champions League; count from fixtures, not from a mined page). Style: 3-4-2-1 with double pivot, 3-2-5 / 3-2-4-1 in attack and 5-2-3 / 5-4-1 / 5-3-2 without the ball; sources also call it 3-4-3, 3-5-2 or 3-4-1-2, so the label is unsettled. Pressing is described both as possession-first with a mid-block (The Boar) and as an aggressive pressing trap plus counter-pressing (Coaches' Voice, Tuchel); the conflict is kept in openQuestions. Contrast with chelsea-2016-17 (Conte, 3-4-3).
openQuestions: Pressing label: The Boar (Feb 2021) says Chelsea prioritise possession over pressing; Coaches' Voice and FourFourTwo describe aggressive pressing, a pressing trap and counter-pressing. Probably phase-dependent (mid-block early, higher press from March/April).
Coaches' Voice Tuchel profile (page dated 2024) describes Chelsea with Alonso/Chilwell and a 'more recently introduced' pressing trap; dated 2020/21 by content, not by a dated match.
Formation name differs by source: 3-4-2-1 (Spielverlagerung, Pride of London, CV final), 3-5-2 (CV Real Madrid), 3-4-3 (Goal, Wolves).

Set-piece marking in the spell not verified: only Tuchel's 'match up physically' remark and a 2022 retrospective claiming man-marking in 2021/22; zonal vs man for 2020/21 unresolved. Chelsea set-piece attacking success (12% of corners) is Lampard-era.
Squad age profile not found in any mined page; Hudson-Odoi (20) and Gilmour loan evidence only.

Start and end dates: 26 Jan appointment and 27 Jan first match rest on the Goal article and a 403 Mastermind URL; 29 May final date is from the CV final report (no explicit date in text). The 15-match unbeaten run not verified from a page (Jorginho article confirms 8 unbeaten, 2 conceded, by 27 Feb).
